auto_context.card: This is an archived gaming live stream uploaded on July 17, 2026, from Korone Ch. 戌神ころね, featuring the VTuber Inugami Korone of hololive Gamers. Despite the stream title referencing "Toilet 64," the game being played is Toilet 8, a comedic indie game available on Steam, iOS, and Android. Korone streams in Japanese with a casual, energetic, and often exaggerated comedic tone typical of her character; the title's "くそお！！！！！！！！！！！！！" (roughly "Damn it!/Crap!") reflects her expressive, reactive streaming style. The tag 生神もんざえもん is a recurring community tag used in her streams.
